$description: Tool-confirmation card contract (wave-XII W2, Claude SDK canUseTool → NEU UI) — pending tool permission shown as a card in the run feed instead of a terminal prompt. Awaiting = needs-attention warning hairline (not a red frame); resolved outcomes collapse to a meta line. Status colors only via state.* dictionary.

bg.$description: Card ground — same chrome level as ToolCallCard.

edge.$description: Left hairline while awaiting — amber 'needs decision', never the red selection frame.

resolvedEdge.$description: Left hairline once resolved (allowed/denied/timeout) — muted, the decision itself is told by the status dot + label.

meta.$description: Tool name echo / requested-at timestamp / resolved-by — mono meta.

fontMono.$description: Tool name and args preview — IBM Plex Mono.

allowBg.$description: «Разрешить» — affirmative accent wash, same language as handoffBar buttons.

denyBg.$description: «Отклонить» — neutral ghost (transparent fill); denying is a normal action, not an error state.
